external_primary_method_evidence.source: S-Bus: Automatic Read-Set Reconstruction for Multi-Agent LLM State Coordination
external_primary_method_evidence.relevant_claim: S-Bus uses a server-side DeliveryLog of observed GET operations to reconstruct per-agent read sets at commit time rather than trusting agent self-report; its Observable-Read Isolation safety applies only to the observable read projection and explicitly preserves a hidden-read coverage boundary.

current_clay_gap.observation: Current physical GRID10 source can bind process PID, barrier liveness, exact S1 generation/epoch/digest and immutable packet digest, while a self-authored packet/read receipt would still be weaker than an independently observed record of what bytes/read-set the producer actually consumed.
current_clay_gap.why_material: A producer could in principle compute a payload from an unobserved/stale read and then emit internally consistent current metadata unless exact source/runtime instrumentation makes that impossible or independently observable.

transfer_hypothesis.name: FABRIC_OBSERVED_READSET_LEDGER
transfer_hypothesis.claim: Move consumed-read attestation out of NODE_RESULT self-report and into deterministic fabric/runtime observation. For every admitted ordinary-node read path, record the exact delivered snapshot/read-set identity before cognition; bind the resulting read_receipt_id to node membership identity, process identity and the eventual packet_digest at cohort admission.
transfer_hypothesis.authority: DETERMINISTIC_FABRIC_OBSERVATION_ONLY; model output cannot mint or edit the ledger

critical_difference_from_sbus.sbus_topology: HTTP-observable shared-state reads with explicitly incomplete hidden-read coverage in some workloads
critical_difference_from_sbus.clay_target: A much narrower Typed Entry/S1 read ABI can aim to make every cognition-relevant admitted read traverse one deterministic observer, reducing or eliminating the hidden-read class for the bounded runtime contract.
critical_difference_from_sbus.warning: If ordinary Xeno code retains unrestricted direct SQLite/file/memory access outside the observed ABI, unobserved reads remain possible and FABRIC_OBSERVED_READSET_LEDGER must report PARTIAL_COVERAGE rather than full consumed-input attestation.

design_options.name: OBSERVED_READ_FACADE
design_options.mechanism: Serve all allowed S1 snapshot/read operations through one deterministic read facade that logs exact returned object/row digests; NODE_RESULT receives only a read_receipt_id and cannot invent its contents.
design_options.strength: Strongest clean authority separation if direct bypass is prevented by the runtime capability boundary.
design_options.cost: Changes current direct-read process path and requires a bypass-negative test.

design_options.name: SOURCE_BOUND_SQLITE_READ_INSTRUMENTATION
design_options.mechanism: Keep direct read-only SQLite but bind exact producer source/runtime plus deterministic trace/read-set instrumentation and a parent-observed receipt channel.
design_options.strength: Smaller migration from current physical GRID10 harness.
design_options.cost: Harder to prove that all cognition-relevant reads are observed; trace callbacks alone may not establish consumed returned-byte identity.

counterhypothesis: For bounded physical GRID10 component credit, exact source hash + ten live read-only SQLite transactions + same snapshot identity + parent PID/packet binding may already be sufficient; a generic observed-read ledger may only be necessary before stronger model/J-Space or production-grade consumed-input claims.

cheapest_high_information_discriminator.name: DECLARED_CURRENT_CONSUMED_STALE_BYPASS_NEGATIVE
cheapest_high_information_discriminator.test: Construct a test-only producer path that is allowed to compute from a stale/unobserved snapshot while emitting otherwise current-looking declared metadata. The existing acceptance should fail if current source binding already excludes this path; otherwise the fabric-observed read ledger must detect a read_receipt/current-snapshot mismatch before batch admission.
cheapest_high_information_discriminator.promotion_rule: Do not add general consumed-input attestation credit unless a bypass-negative proves that unobserved cognition-relevant reads cannot enter the admitted path or are detected fail-closed.

training_eval_reinjection.hard_negative: A self-reported read receipt or current-looking packet metadata is not independent proof of the bytes/state actually consumed.
training_eval_reinjection.positive_behavior: Preserve UNKNOWN unless consumed input is source-bound or independently observed; distinguish observation metadata from observed delivery evidence.

next_exact_action: After current atomic same-cohort and membership-source binding is source-reviewed, add one bypass-negative around the exact producer read path. If it can emit a current-looking result from an unobserved/stale read, implement OBSERVED_READ_FACADE first; if exact source/runtime binding already excludes the path, retain this ledger as the next stronger model/J-Space consumed-input gate rather than inflating current component scope.
